# SoraBadge

A short status or category label.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { SoraBadge } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraBadge from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraBadge'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/SoraBadge.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/SoraBadge.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'solid' \| 'soft' \| 'outline'` |  | Visual variant. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` |  | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `dot` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a small status dot before the label (decorative; the text carries the meaning). |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  |  |
| `leading` |  | Icon before the label. |

## Attributes

The `<span>` element.

## Accessibility

- Purely visual: the text carries the meaning; the optional dot is decorative.

## Styling

- `.sora-badge`, `.sora-badge__dot`
- `data-variant`, `data-color`, `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-2">
  <div
    v-for="variant in ['soft', 'solid', 'outline'] as const"
    :key="variant"
    class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"
  >
    <SoraBadge v-for="color in colors" :key="color" :variant="variant" :color="color">{{
      t('demo.badge.new')
    }}</SoraBadge>
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
    <SoraBadge size="sm">{{ t('demo.badge.beta') }}</SoraBadge>
    <SoraBadge color="success" dot>{{ t('demo.badge.active') }}</SoraBadge>
    <SoraBadge size="lg" color="error" dot>{{ t('demo.badge.failed') }}</SoraBadge>
  </div>
</div>
```
